messages.text: I need to report another bicycle theft. The September case was for my old bicycle, BIKE-FIRST-1.
Is the October 6 incident in your new report the same event with a corrected date?
No. I bought a replacement; BIKE-SECOND-2 was stolen in a separate incident on October 6 at home. Use the report and email I supplied.

routing.description: new_intake means a different incident; update_existing means a clear matching incident; clarify_duplicate means the match is uncertain.

incident_ref.description: Supplied report record for the requested intake.

existing_claim_to_update.description: Existing claim ID to update, or null if none is the same incident.

review_reasons.description: Unordered workflow review reason codes; empty when none is established.
